scheme_name: Livelihood Support To Marine Fishermen During Fishing Ban Period
occupation: crew member of a motorized boat
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be an active marine fisherman
Only one member per family is eligible
Beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Odisha and provide identity and residence proof such as Aadhaar card
Beneficiary must have a bank account in his/her own name in Odisha
If the beneficiary is a boat owner, he/she must have a valid boat registration (Real Craft) and a valid fishing license
If the beneficiary is a crew member, he/she must work on a registered fishing boat with a valid fishing license and provide a certificate from the boat owner
If the beneficiary is a fish trader or involved in sorting/grading, he/she must provide a certificate from a registered boat owner
Beneficiary must not belong to the automatically excluded households under SECC‑2011
benefits_summary: One member per family receives ₹15,000 annually, disbursed as a single Direct Benefit Transfer payment.
documents_required: Bank account statement or passbook in applicant’s name
Valid boat registration (Real Craft) (for boat owners)
Valid fishing licence (for boat owners and crew)
Certificate from registered boat owner (for crew members and fish traders)
